title: Confidence worked examples: visits and age together decide the grade
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance, press New schedule and create a throwaway schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' holding one routine service per reading you will seed, named 'ZZ Seed 1', 'ZZ Seed 2' and so on, each with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and no canned lines. Save. (If it already exists, reuse it.)
  3. In Settings > Maintenance create a schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' with one service 'PM-M': a Distance trigger set At 360,000 mileage and a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months. Save.
  4. Create five units, 'ZZAUTOTEST 540' to 'ZZAUTOTEST 544', each as follows: Open Customers > 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' > Assets and create unit '<unit>' with New Asset, leaving Mileage and Engine Hours empty. On its Maintenance tab press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' and give every seed service a last service date five years ago (for example 6 Oct 2021), so each seed service reads Overdue and shows on the work order card; press Enroll. Enroll the unit on 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' too, with PM-M last done today.
  5. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 540' (oldest first): 1) 26 Sep 2026 · 300,000 mileage. (one visit)
  6. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 541' (oldest first): 1) 5 Sep 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 5 Oct 2026 · 303,000 mileage. (two visits, the last one yesterday)
  7. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 542' (oldest first): 1) 28 Feb 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 20 Mar 2026 · 302,000 mileage; 3) 9 Apr 2026 · 304,000 mileage; 4) 29 Apr 2026 · 306,000 mileage; 5) 19 May 2026 · 308,000 mileage; 6) 8 Jun 2026 · 310,000 mileage. (six visits, five pairs, the last 120 days old)
  8. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 543' (oldest first): 1) 11 May 2023 · 200,000 mileage; 2) 10 Aug 2023 · 209,100 mileage; 3) 9 Nov 2023 · 218,200 mileage; 4) 8 Feb 2024 · 227,300 mileage; 5) 9 May 2024 · 236,400 mileage; 6) 8 Aug 2024 · 245,500 mileage; 7) 7 Nov 2024 · 254,600 mileage; 8) 6 Feb 2025 · 263,700 mileage; 9) 8 May 2025 · 272,800 mileage; 10) 7 Aug 2025 · 281,900 mileage; 11) 6 Nov 2025 · 291,000 mileage; 12) 5 Feb 2026 · 300,100 mileage. (twelve visits about three months apart over three years, the last 243 days, about eight months, old)
  9. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 544' (oldest first): 1) 10 Nov 2022 · 200,000 mileage; 2) 9 Feb 2023 · 209,100 mileage; 3) 11 May 2023 · 218,200 mileage; 4) 10 Aug 2023 · 227,300 mileage; 5) 9 Nov 2023 · 236,400 mileage; 6) 8 Feb 2024 · 245,500 mileage; 7) 9 May 2024 · 254,600 mileage; 8) 8 Aug 2024 · 263,700 mileage; 9) 7 Nov 2024 · 272,800 mileage; 10) 6 Feb 2025 · 281,900 mileage; 11) 8 May 2025 · 291,000 mileage; 12) 7 Aug 2025 · 300,100 mileage. (the same pattern as 543, but the last visit fourteen months, 425 days, ago)
  10. Dates are for a run on 6 Oct 2026. On another day, move every date by the same number of days and seed and read on the same day, because an estimate and a reading's age both count days up to today.
  11. Seed each reading in the table, oldest first: open Work Orders and press New Work Order for the unit; type the reading's mileage in the work order's Mileage field (and its engine hours in Engine Hours where the table gives one; leave the field untouched where it does not) and save; expand the Maintenance schedule card, open the three-dot menu of a seed service not used yet, choose Mark complete, keep On a work order with this work order chosen, set Reset date to the reading's date and press Mark complete. That work order's values become readings dated the Reset date. Confirm any warning the field shows.
  12. When every reading is in: on the unit's Maintenance tab open the 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' schedule's menu, choose Remove from schedule and confirm, so the seed services add no rows. Check the Mileage card's last recorded value and date match the table's last reading.
custom_steps:
1. Open each unit's Maintenance tab and read the confidence under PM-M's due month, or what the row shows instead.
  2. For 543, count by hand the readings from the last 24 months (730 days): the six from 243 to 698 days ago, giving five pairs.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 540, one visit: nothing is computed; the row reads No data and the calendar governs (one usable pair is the floor).
  • 541, two visits, the last yesterday: one pair, under 30 days → Medium.
  • 542, six visits, five pairs, last reading 120 days old → Medium.
  • 543, twelve visits over three years, the last eight months ago → Medium (five usable pairs inside 24 months, 181 to 365 days old).
  • 544, the same unit fourteen months after its last visit → Low.
  • A unit whose every reading is older than 24 months reads No data and the calendar governs (checked in the 24-month cut-off case).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E5: “Two visits, the last one yesterday: one pair, under 30 days, Medium. Six visits, five pairs, the last reading 120 days old: Medium. Twelve visits over three years, the last one eight months ago: Medium. The same unit fourteen months after its last visit: Low. Every reading older than 24 months: No data, and the calendar governs”
  • S11-E2: “One usable pair, which is two visits in a clean history, is the floor at which anything is computed”
  • S18-R19: “Mark complete On a work order also records that work order's mileage and engine hours as the asset's readings, dated the Reset date”
